title: Inverse-image compatibility on affine Cech cocycles
statement: Let $R,S$ be commutative rings, $X,Y$ schemes [def-pc-scheme], $g:Y\to X$, $f:X\to\operatorname{Spec}R$, and $f':Y\to\operatorname{Spec}S$. Let $U=(U_i)_{i\in I}$ and $V=(V_i)_{i\in I}$ be open covers, with every tuple intersection affine and $V_{i_0\ldots i_k}\subseteq g^{-1}U_{i_0\ldots i_k}$. Let $M,N$ be quasi-coherent modules [pqf-def-coherent] on $X,Y$, and $\varphi:M\to g_*N$. Use the ordered Cech complexes and coordinates of [lem-pc-flat-cech-base-change], and the cohomology, exact inverse image, constant integer sheaf comparison and adjoint coefficient map of [def-pc-flat-cohomology-comparison]. For every $q\in\mathbb N$, there are $R$-linear and $S$-linear Leray isomorphisms $e:H^q(C(U,M))\simeq HOver(f,M,q)$ and $e':H^q(C(V,N))\simeq HOver(f',N,q)$ such that any cycles $z,z'$ whose coordinates satisfy $z'_{i_0\ldots i_q}=\varphi(z_{i_0\ldots i_q})|_{V_{i_0\ldots i_q}}$ have $e'([z'])=H(\operatorname{coeff}(g,\varphi))(H(\operatorname{invImage}g,\operatorname{constIso}(g)^{-1})(e([z])))$. No scalar-algebra relation between the two bases, finiteness of $I$, or flatness is required.

proof.text: Obtain normalized additive comparison systems for the two covers with compatibility on matching cocycles in all degrees. No affine acyclicity or isomorphism is used at this step.

Apply affine bijectivity and scalar linearity to each supplied system using the original affine-intersection and quasi-coherence hypotheses. Build each linear map from its additive map and the scalar identity; LinearEquiv.ofBijective then gives the required module-category isomorphisms. Their hom maps are definitionally the supplied additive comparisons, so the inverse-image compatibility specializes to the desired equality. No system is chosen as data of any definition.
